p|panel|lente_cert_s2: This computer makes it from its chained log and you keep it: GUARDIANA sends it to nobody.
p|panel|lente_cert_pendiente: The figures appear once you make the certificate for a period.
p|panel|lente_borrado_lead: A letter ready to send, citing the law where you live, to each company that keeps your data.
p|panel|lente_borrado_s1: Almost every country with a data protection law requires companies to delete your personal data when you ask.
p|panel|lente_borrado_s2: GUARDIANA prepares the letter and counts the deadline; you do the sending.
p|panel|lente_exp_lead: Every request to a company, with its legal deadline and what happened.
p|panel|lente_exp_s1: GUARDIANA counts the days of each request and tells you when the deadline is up.
p|panel|lente_exp_s2: If they do not answer, it prepares the complaint to the authority. Everything stays on this computer.
p|panel|lente_reglas_lead: What is blocked and what is allowed, and who decided it.
p|panel|lente_reglas_s1: No rule exists unless you create it.
p|panel|lente_reglas_s2: Every block records who decided it and when. Undoing never deletes: it records that it was undone.
p|panel|lente_hx_lead: Three tools that work here, without any file leaving this computer.
p|panel|lente_hx_s1: Blackout mode blocks everything that is not essential; Clean file removes the hidden data in a photo or a document.
p|panel|lente_hx_s2: And before installing, see who signed the installer. GUARDIANA looks at the file and does not keep it.
p|panel|lente_hogar_lead: This PC as the DNS guardian of the home Wi-Fi, without installing anything on other devices.
p|panel|lente_hogar_s1: With Home Mode, phones, the TV and everything on the Wi-Fi go through GUARDIANA.
p|panel|lente_hogar_s2: Each device connects once, with a QR code or from the router.
p|panel|lente_lic_lead: Your plan, your devices and every time GUARDIANA talked to the license server.
p|panel|lente_lic_s1: Without a license GUARDIANA does not switch off: it moves to Free and keeps watching this computer.
p|panel|lente_lic_s2: Plus (monthly, yearly or Lifetime) adds the whole history, several devices, alerts, automatic blocks and reports.
p|panel|lente_verify_lead: Facts, not promises: this program's signature and public record.
p|panel|lente_verify_s1: The same thing guardiana verify prints: if something does not add up, it shows here.
p|panel|lente_verify_s2: The signature proves who made this program; the public record, that it is the same version everyone gets.
p|panel|lente_estado_lead: How GUARDIANA is running on this computer.
p|panel|lente_estado_s1: GUARDIANA answers this computer's DNS queries and records them.
p|panel|lente_estado_s2: The lists say what is tracking, advertising or telemetry. They come inside the program and are renewed with each version.
p|panel|lente_ficha_lead: Who it is, what it does, and how often your home called it.
p|panel|lente_ficha_s1: One profile per company: its headquarters, its trade and what your home exchanged with it.
p|panel|lente_ficha_s2: If it keeps your data, you can ask it to delete them with a letter ready to send.
p|panel|lente_ficha_accion: Ask it to delete your data
p|panel|ct_motivo_propio: It is a GUARDIANA program: its connections (license, updates and relay servers) are documented and never raise notices.

z|accion_desbloquear_titulo: Let this site through on every page, except your marked data, which never goes to another company without your “Send”. You can block it again whenever you like.
z|accion_rebloquear_titulo: You allowed it: block it again on every page
z|maxima_explica: On top of tracking, advertising and data brokers, it blocks other companies’ telemetry and every ping a page sends to another company only to carry information out, and it rejects cookie notices. If a website stops working properly, allow that site right here.
z|proteccion: Block trackers, advertising and data brokers
z|proteccion_explica: Only what a page asks of other companies: those the open lists know as tracking or advertising, and those registered as data brokers. The page you open is never blocked.
z|cookies_ajuste_explica: On the notices of the most used cookie managers (OneTrust, Cookiebot, Didomi and others), GUARDIANA ZERO presses “Reject all”. If the notice has no such button, it hides it without accepting anything. The rest of the page is left alone.
z|emergentes_ajuste_explica: Does not open the windows a page opens on its own or when you click anywhere on it, nor those that lead to advertising or tracking. Closes the boxes a page puts on top without you asking (newsletters, “turn on notifications”, “get the app”) and says “no” to pages that ask to send you notifications before you have pressed anything. If a window you wanted did not open, the shield lets you open it.
z|proteccion_apagada: Blocking is off: you are only watching.

z|mandato_boton_titulo: Give your AI a task with limits set by the browser, not by the AI
z|mandato_explica: Your AI does the task in a separate tab that can only go to the websites you choose. If a page tries to take it somewhere else, that is blocked: the limit is set by the browser, not by the AI. When it is done you keep a signed receipt of what it did.
z|mandato_tarea_ph: For example: find a Bogotá–Madrid flight for 12 December
z|mandato_webs_ph: Separate them with commas: avianca.com, google.com
z|mandato_estricto: Strict: from content delivery networks, only images, styles, fonts and scripts, and never from a name a customer rents there (like x.cloudfront.net)
z|mandato_senuelo_explica: If your AI has to give an email, give it this one instead of yours. It belongs to nobody: if any website tries to take it, that is blocked and you will see it here.
z|mandato_cuentas: Pages opened: {visitas}. Sites: {sitios}. Attempts blocked: {cortes}. Times your data was sent: {datos}.
z|recibo_explica: The signature shows that this receipt has not changed since it was signed with this computer’s key (its fingerprint is in Settings). It covers what the task’s tab saw; it does not prove what happened outside it.
z|tinta_explica: Write the data you want watched. If any of it leaves for a company other than the website where you typed it, it is blocked: as written, encoded, or turned into a hash code, which is how advertising networks pass it around. It only goes out if you send it yourself: with “Send” when the browser asks you, or by typing the address yourself; allowing a site does not let it through. It is kept only on this computer and no page sees it.
